abilities.name: Storm Bow
abilities.description: Mana: 20 Cooldown: 4 seconds Activate to charge an arrow that deals 291 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy hit. Storm Bow's range increases the longer it is Channeled.

abilities.name: Scatter Arrow
abilities.description: Mana: 50 Cooldown: 8 seconds Fire an arrow that deals 88 (+4% per level) to the first enemy Hero hit. Scatter Arrow can collide with terrain and Structures, splitting into 5 arrows that travel extra distance, ricochet up to 4 additional times, and deal 88 (+4% per level) damage each to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Sonic Arrow
abilities.description: Mana: 50 Cooldown: 20 seconds Fire an arrow that grants vision in a large area for 5 seconds. Enemies inside are revealed for 1 second. If Sonic Arrow lands directly on an enemy, it deals 165 (+4% per level) damage to them and follows them as they move.

abilities.name: Dragonstrike
abilities.description: Mana: 60 Cooldown: 60 seconds After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

abilities.name: Dragon's Arrow
abilities.description: Mana: 90 Cooldown: 70 seconds Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Natural Agility
abilities.description: Cooldown: 25 seconds Jump over unpathable terrain or Structures, up to a maximum range.

abilities.name: Summon Mount
abilities.description: Cooldown: 4 seconds After Channeling for 1 second, gain 30% Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Hearthstone
abilities.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Mana.

abilities.name: Play of the Game
abilities.description: Activate to teleport to Hanzo's Dragon's Arrow.

talents.name: Target Practice
talents.description: Quest: Hit every enemy Hero with Storm Bow.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero once with Storm Bow, its range is increased by 30%.  Reward: After hitting every enemy Hero 3 times with Storm Bow, its damage is increased by 100.

talents.name: Simple Geometry
talents.description: Quest: Hit a Hero with multiple arrows from the same Scatter Arrow cast 20 times. Each arrow hit after the second grants additional progress.  Reward: Upon hitting terrain for the first time, Scatter Arrow creates 2 additional arrows.

talents.name: Redemption
talents.description: Quest: Every 2 Basic Attacks against the same Hero within 10 seconds grants 1 Redemption, stacking up to 12. Dying decreases Redemption by 3, and Redemption can be lost even at maximum stacks.  Reward: At 12 Redemption, gain 50% Attack Speed.

talents.name: Explosive Arrows
talents.description: Upon hitting a Minion or Monster, Storm Bow deals 60% of its damage to enemies around its target.

talents.name: Serrated Arrows
talents.description: Scatter Arrow deals 100% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

talents.name: Ignore All Distractions
talents.description: Basic Attacks instantly kill Minions and increase Hanzo's Basic Attack range by 2 for 3 seconds.

talents.name: The Dragon Hungers
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 5% Spell Power for 12 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

talents.name: Never Outmatched
talents.description: Reduce Scatter Arrow's Mana cost from 50 to 30. Basic Attacks against Heroes lower the cooldown of Scatter Arrow by 3 seconds.

talents.name: Sharpened Arrowheads
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow or Basic Attacks reduces their Armor by 3 for 3 seconds, up to a maximum reduction of 20 Armor.

talents.name: Dragonstrike
talents.description: Mana: 60 Cooldown: 60 seconds After 1.5 seconds, summon a pair of Spirit Dragons which travel forward, dealing 84 (+4% per level) damage every 0.25 seconds to enemy Heroes in its area. Enemies in the center take 75% increased damage.

talents.name: Dragon's Arrow
talents.description: Mana: 90 Cooldown: 70 seconds Fire a missile that travels across the battleground. Explodes upon hitting an enemy Hero, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.  After traveling a medium distance, the damage is increased to 260 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 1.25 seconds.  After traveling a long distance, the damage is increased to 390 (+4% per level) and the Stun duration to 2 seconds.

talents.name: Fleet of Foot
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow grants 10% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 30%.

talents.name: Ninja Assassin
talents.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow lowers Natural Agility's cooldown by 10 seconds. Additionally, Hero Takedowns reset Natural Agility's cooldown.

talents.name: Mounted Archery
talents.description: Reduce the cooldown of Summon Mount by 2 seconds. Upon mounting, gain 25% additional Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Using Natural Agility instantly mounts.

talents.name: Flawless Technique
talents.description: Hitting Heroes with Storm Bow increases the damage of Hanzo's next Basic Attack within 5 seconds by 40%. Basic Attacks against Heroes increase the damage of Hanzo's next Storm Bow within 5 seconds by 40%.

talents.name: Piercing Arrows
talents.description: Storm Bow and Scatter Arrow pierce, hitting an additional enemy. Additionally, Scatter Arrow can pierce through 1 enemy each time it ricochets.

talents.name: Giant Slayer
talents.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Scatter Arrow and Basic Attacks take a bonus 1.6% of their maximum Health as damage.

talents.name: The Dragon Awakens
talents.description: Hitting a Hero with Storm Bow, Scatter Arrow, or Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Dragonstrike by 4 seconds.

talents.name: Play of the Game
talents.description: While in flight or for up to 2 seconds after impacting a target, Dragon's Arrow can be reactivated to teleport to its location and jump backwards. If used after impact, Hanzo shoots arrows that deal 132 (+4% per level) damage to each target hit by the impact.  Hanzo is Unstoppable during Play of the Game.

talents.name: Bullseye
talents.description: Increase Sonic Arrow's speed and center radius by 100%. Additionally, Heroes hit by Sonic Arrow's center are Stunned for 1 second.

talents.name: Perfect Agility
talents.description: Natural Agility gains a 2nd charge and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
